name: design-skills
description: Design skills for AI agents, from the Design Harness. Install all of them or one workflow at a time.

plugins.name: design-skills
plugins.description: All 69 design skills: research, UX, content, accessibility, build, review, and handoff.

plugins.name: design-understand
plugins.description: Frame the problem before designing: assumptions, objects, decisions, strategy, and priorities.

plugins.name: design-research
plugins.description: Plan, run, and synthesize research: screeners, test guides, synthesis, insights, and share-outs.

plugins.name: design-shape
plugins.description: Shape interaction, content, motion, accessibility, and responsive behaviour.

plugins.name: design-build
plugins.description: Build screens on real design tokens and components, and keep Figma and code in sync.

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Critique and check work before sharing: UX patterns, accessibility, live pages, and audits.

plugins.name: design-handoff
plugins.description: Explain decisions and hand work off: rationale, handoff specs, reports, decks, and writing.

plugins.name: design-operate
plugins.description: Run the practice around the work: setup, memory, debt, scheduling, tickets, and team coaching.
